positive: Before committing this staged multi-module edit, score its fan-out of unfollowed dependents and any hook-to-runtime boundary crossing
Right before git commit, confirm the staged paths stay inside the plan's editable fence, no paired artifact is left behind, and record an escape hatch for the intended crossing
near_negative: Find who calls a module before planning an edit to it
Preview and authorize a force push to the shared branch
Diagnose why the retest went red after the last edit

behavior_assertions.assert: The atlas declares the dependency-direction boundary check the flow's step 4 runs.
The fence audit takes the staged paths the flow's step 5 passes.
The skill's own bundle validates structurally.

behavior_assertions: A fan-out is scored only from a graph that verify has proven, never from a stale snapshot - proven in tests/test_godmode_impact_gate.py on a bare temp project.
An intended crossing is accepted only through a recorded impact-accepted decision naming the path and the reason.
